item.title: Gold Glove-winning Red Sox infielder leaves game due to shoulder injury
item.description: A former Gold Glove winner looking to make the Red Sox as a non-roster invitee left Wednesday's game with a right shoulder injury.

item.title: Bird flu outbreak in California elephant seals prompts officials to cancel popular tours
item.description: They call it the first detected outbreak in marine mammals in California.

item.title: Maduro’s lawyer says US is blocking Venezuela government from paying deposed leader’s drug defense
item.description: The dispute over Maduro’s legal fees is intimately linked to U.S. foreign policy.

item.title: New York sues Counter-Strike game developer saying ‘loot boxes’ promote gambling
item.description: One item, an AK-47 Counter-Strike skin, recently sold for more than $1 million.

item.title: No-parking zone in Nancy Guthrie’s neighborhood widened amid complaints about journalists, streamers
item.description: The new restrictions take effect Thursday.

item.title: Yankees bringing in Randal Grichuk as non-roster invitee
item.description: The Yankees have finally found an outfielder who hits from the right side.

item.title: UConn lands knockout blows early in historic 72-40 Big East beatdown of St. John’s
item.description: The UConn men's basketball team blew past No. 15 St. John's, 72-40, in its most dominant effort of the season, led by a career-game from center Tarris Reed Jr.

item.title: Celtics turn in season-worst shooting performance in loss to Nuggets
item.description: The Celtics stalled out in the final game of their West Coast road trip, turning in a season-worst shooting performance in a loss to the Nuggets.
